verses.3160: fayā qawmu mālī ʿani l-mawti sālī
verses.3162: wa ḥawlī rijālu ʿalā mithli ḥālī
verses.3164: fabuʾusā wa saḥqā lahum min rijāli
verses.3166: bizaydi wa ʿamri wa qīli waqāli
verses.3167: fayā ṣāḥi mahlā ʾa ʾasluku jahla
verses.3170: liman lāḥa shaybu lahu fī l-qadhāli
verses.3172: wa mā ʾin tamurru l-manūnu bibālī
verses.3177: fayā dhā l-jalāli wa yā dhā l-jamāli
verses.3178: wa yā dhā l-maʿālī ʿalayka ʾāttikālī
verses.3179: fakun ʿinda ẓannī wa lā tuslimannī
verses.3182: wa minka l-ʿaṭāʾu fahab lī suʾāʾālī
